_comment: Documents the Ask assistant reads, beyond the Daily Bulletin and the newsletter archive, which fetch_corpus.mjs discovers on its own. `pages` are HTML pages on stjacademy.org; `pdfs` are downloaded and text-extracted. `newsletters` are extra Constant Contact 'View as Webpage' links for issues the archive page has not listed yet — the newest few are usually missing. Policy documents carry no date on purpose: they are current until replaced here.
